This is a read-only/deterministic-init global, which is SAFE per the taxonomy.

**C5 ITERATOR_LEAK**: No iterators are created in this code.

The code imports `time` but only uses it for type definitions in the struct, not for any time-based operations in transaction logic. The global map is read-only and accessed by key, not iterated. All state operations use deterministic key-based access.
